dedupe_keys.name: carris and metro public transit usage maps

description: The deposited HTML map collection contains separate CARRIS and METRO ridership layers for 2019 and 2020, absolute and percentage change maps, and a standalone CARRIS map. Station/stop points expose names and associated metrics. The source-linked pandemic study and catalogue relation identify the maps as a developed output of that analysis. These are rendered data products, not an independent simulation engine or raw smart-card release. Neither usage values nor geographic completeness were inspected. The catalogue labels author copyright while native metadata provides no licence. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
